2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 323, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution case, this petitioner took obscene photographs of the complainant and threatened her to make it viral.

It is further alleged that on the alleged date and time of occurrence,
this petitioner forcibly took the complainant in banana orchard and committed rape with her.
4. It is submitted that petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case due to village politics.
There is no eye- witness of the occurrence.
There is delay of four months in lodging of the complaint case for which there is no plausible explanation.
Complainant is major and was in love with this Patna High Court CR.
5. Counsel for State however vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the complainant in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C has duly supported the prosecution case.
